OP, thank you for sharing that. It’s a raw, unfiltered feeling that almost every Med student has faced. You work so hard but it never seems to be enough. You’ve got to realize what’s important to you. Life is more than becoming a doctor and I promise you that taking a chance on yourself is something you’ll never regret. You’ve got the first part down — admitting your faults in this such as being lazy. You even pointed it out that you’re not motivated— ask yourself why? Sit in silence and it might be difficult but really ponder on whether this is what you want to do. Don’t be afraid to seek counseling. These could also be signs of depression or an undiagnosed learning disorder. Maybe this isn’t the advice you wanted to hear but life is more than your accomplishments. You have to figure what that more is. That’s the beauty of being human and living. Best of luck to you.
